lines.text: Minute 38 of a 40-minute run. The process dies.
Normally that means re-run, re-pay, re-explain. Here, everything is already saved.
Every step checkpointed — messages, tool results, approvals, the meter. Written after every single call — not at the end, when it's too late.
Relaunch. The session resumes at the exact step it stopped. Not from the top — from step seven.
State intact. Meter intact. Seven completed tool results — no re-execution, no re-payment.
The crash costs you a heartbeat. Not the work. The meter never blinked.

bgm.query: dark-tech minimal ambient, slow build, one impact at the restored meter (~33s)
